title: The Spellblade

hybrid.label: Hybrid
hybrid.description: A hybrid activity incorporates a Strike, but can be adapted just as easily to your Battlecasts instead. You can Battlecast instead of Strike when using a hybrid action, using Battlecast’s action cost if it’s higher. If you Battlecast as part of a hybrid activity, increase the value of the overloaded condition you gain from Battlecast by the hybrid activity’s action cost-1. You can’t use Battlecast as part of a hybrid activity if you’re overloaded at the start of the activity, even if you would lose the condition before making a Strike, and if you Battlecast as part of the activity, any subsequent attacks you make as part of the activity don’t reduce your overloaded condition.

description: A homebrew class for Pathfinder Second Edition based on the Magus, which expands significantly upon its Spellstrike action.
